two_pass_rule: final = pass-1 two-arm reconcile, then pass-2 population check over pass-1 uncertain; excluded only where pass-1 LLM off_topic AND pass-2 'no listed population studied' (both with verbatim spans), or both pass-1 arms agree; remaining uncertain extracted and flagged

instrument_alarm.action: STOP - audit the screening prompt for a closed in-scope list before trusting either arm
instrument_alarm.audit_2026-10-07: Alarm is degenerate on an anchor-drawn roster (rule arm cannot fire on papers drawn by the anchor terms); LLM off-topic calls audited on a sample and found sound (abbreviation collisions, single-joint orthopaedics, incidental mentions). Pass-2 population check added as the independent arm; see two_pass_rule.

instrument_alarm_note: screen_instrument_alarm floors each arm at 1, so with an anchor-drawn roster (rule off_topic == 0 by construction) ANY llm off_topic count >= 3 fires. Audit the LLM off_topic list by title before treating the alarm as a prompt fault.
basis: denominator = every rostered paper in the target chunks. final_verdict follows helpers.screen_reconcile: off_topic ONLY when both arms agree (or LLM off_topic with no rule anchor) -> excluded and listed in *_excluded_pmids.csv; an LLM off_topic against a rule-arm anchor -> uncertain -> EXTRACTED and flagged (screen_verdict_uncertain) and listed in *_llm_offtopic_flagged.csv for adjudication; LLM uncertain -> uncertain.
